name: ACE-S RouterBench
description: Layer-level routing fixtures for ACE-S activation, domain, modifier, and fidelity evaluation. These are ground-truth cases, not measured model results.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound friendlier: I cannot attend tomorrow.
What is the capital of France?
Given this complete function in the prompt, explain what the for-loop does. No repository lookup is needed.
In this repository, find where ContextDecision is defined and explain which fields control retrieval.
If I rename this public method, which tests and callers in the repo are likely to break?
Quote the exact enum values accepted by this API from the current source file.
In this 180-page specification, find the section that defines retry behavior before reading the whole document.
From this long policy PDF, quote the exact clause governing cancellation fees.
Compare three recent papers on context compression and tell me where their findings disagree.
Analyze this GitHub repository and compare its architecture with the newest relevant research, then recommend the next implementation step.
These two sources give different current API limits. Determine which one controls today.
What API limit did the documentation state on January 1, 2024? The historical date is fixed.
Investigate the bug now, but preserve the exact constraints and evidence another agent will need to implement the fix later.
I need to inspect an unknown binary artifact but do not yet know which available tool can read it. Find the smallest suitable capability first.
Explain why the phrase 'latest update' can be ambiguous in technical documentation, without checking any current product.
Rewrite this title: Research methods for beginners.
Use this long regulation PDF and current official amendments to determine the rule that applies today, with exact citations.
Trace this repository issue, but first determine which installed code-search capability can resolve symbol references efficiently.
I may have enough information in the pasted excerpt, but one omitted table could change the conclusion. Decide whether one bounded check is needed.
The tool returned 50,000 lines of logs. Keep only what the next debugging step needs while preserving a route back to the raw output.
